This project is designed to consider the state of an enterprises’ current AI commits and use it to inform LLM routing decisions alongside other common variables (price, performance, etc.). items.title: Show HN: Hatoba, an open-source SSH client with an AI assistant and E2EE sync
items.summary: I've used SSH tools for years and didn't really plan on building yet another SSH client, but I ended up building one the way I wanted. Hatoba is a desktop SSH client for Windows, Linux and macOS. It's written in Rust with Tauri 2 and MIT licensed. Each terminal has an AI assistant panel next to it. You describe the problem, and it reads the terminal screen, runs commands, types into the shell, and reads, edits and searches files on the host to find the cause and fix it.
